sources.title: Empty-input closure: accepted full EPSC/PSC equivalence
sources.used_for: Earlier ordinary deductive equivalence of full EPSC and PSC. Ground extraction yields full EPSC, so EPSC2 parameter packing is not necessary.

sources.title: Equality-free EPSC with two fixed parameter slots
sources.used_for: Inherited exact EPSC2 wrapper and ordinary ZFC-level consistency calibration. Matrices have free variables among x,y,p,q; arbitrary internal binders.

sources.title: Raw PSC: hereditary-saturation interpretation and formalization
sources.used_for: Ordinary saturation interpretation and distinction from unfinished complete first-order Lean interpretation.

sources.title: Subset-only positive closure
sources.used_for: Extensional PSC / ZF without Foundation and Choice calibration.

sources.title: Complete ground-clause reference for PSC
sources.used_for: Comparison with existing complete signed-clausification / Skolem / ground-trace interface.

sources.title: Semantics and Proof Theory of the Epsilon Calculus
sources.author: Richard Zach
sources.publication: Logic and Its Applications, ICLA 2017, LNCS 10119, pages 27-47
sources.used_for: Primary exposition of epsilon syntax, critical formulas, quantifier translation, and epsilon semantics. The new proof uses a direct ground-term model, without invoking epsilon extensionality or the first epsilon theorem.

priority_scope: Native epsilon/EPSC2 proposal relative to inspected repository components; no general priority claim for epsilon calculus or ground propositional proof reductions.
